name: What materials or tools are typically used for hardware and functional adjustments?

mainEntity.name: What materials or tools are typically used for hardware and functional adjustments?

acceptedAnswer.text: A variety of standard hand tools are typically used for hardware and functional adjustments, including screwdrivers (Phillips and flathead), Allen wrenches, pliers, and occasionally shims or lubricants. Specialized tools might be required for certain types of hardware or complex mechanisms. The specific tools depend on the type of hardware and the nature of the adjustment. Our team arrives prepared with all necessary equipment to handle diverse adjustment needs efficiently.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard hand tools like screwdrivers, Allen wrenches, and pliers are common, with specialized tools used for specific hardware or complex mechanisms.
